newsitem.title: USA: Featherlite drops plan to acquire Camp.
newsitem.headline: Featherlite drops plan to acquire Camp.

text.p: Featherlite Mfg Inc said Wednesday it has dropped its plan to acquire Camp & Associates Inc, a privately held sports marketing company based in Concord, North Carolina, after conducting a due diligence review.

"As the result of the due diligence process, we arrived at the conclusion that this acquisition would not be in the best interests of both companies and mutually agreed to terminate negotiations," Conrad Clement, chief executive of Featherlite, a trailer manufacturer, said in a news release.
Clement also said that Featherlite will continue to develop diversification strategies to capitalize on the opportunities that exist in the leisure and entertainment categories.
Featherlite had signed a letter of intent to acquire Camp in June.
